evidence: WindowEvent::MouseWheel calls translate_mouse_wheel_event with UiPoint::default(). Editor platform_input_translation.rs::runtime_wheel_translation_preserves_precise_pixel_xy_and_legacy_scalar asserts that zero point. Shared UiInputManager::dispatch_window_input_pump_event immediately dispatches Input; surface/input/pointer.rs::dispatch_pointer_input records Scroll event.point before dispatch_pointer_event_for_metadata, which passes that point into surface pointer routing/hit-test. No intervening reconstruction exists. Thus using the published translator->shared pump flow after a cursor move replaces cursor position with origin and routes wheel at origin. Editor events/pointer.rs uses last_pointer_position separately for native scroll but forwards unchanged shared pointer to workbench input.
impact_or_question: Wheel on a non-origin UI control can target origin and reset shared cursor history when caller forwards translator output to shared input manager without custom position reconstruction.
next_action: Carry current pointer position in input context or reconstruct wheel position before shared dispatch; add translator->input-manager regression with two distinct hit targets and prior nonzero cursor move.
